thread:
incident-bot: 🚨 INCIDENT ALERT: Streaming tail latency SLO breach detected on /v1/stream/generate (p99 > SLO). Auto-pager sent to oncall. metric: p99=6.4s (SLO 3s), p95=1.2s (SLO 500ms), error rate spike ~0.3%
Maya: saw the pager — I'm on it. pulling traces now.
Ethan: I opened the dashboard: spike started ~3693456600, correlated with a precision-profile rollout to a subset of GPUs ~20m ago.
Priya: do we have evidence it's the new precision profile (int8-lowscale) or infra noisy neighbors? any CPU/GPU throttling?
Maya: looking at host metrics — GPU util is normal, memory ok. But per-request decode times jumped and we see long stalls in the streamer stage (kv cache hits still normal).
Ethan: logs show repeated DequantizeSlow events in the runtime: `dequantize_loop took >50ms` for many tokens. That's aligning with p99 spikes.
Priya: that lines up with the int8 rollout we pushed earlier — the quant transform used a new scale coeff table. Some scale entries might be mismatched for long-context generation.
Marco: customer-impact note: two enterprise customers (acme-platform, fintech-pro) reported slow real-time completions — CS alerted them and they reported timeouts in their UI. estimated #requests affected ~2.1k/min during peak.
Lena: adding workaround options. We can do: 1) route affected traffic to fp16 variant (slower cost-wise) 2) toggle precision-profile auto-fallback 3) rollback rollout. Which is fastest?
Ethan: fastest immediate: enable route-level fallback to fp16 for streaming endpoints — that's a config flip and should hit within 30s. rollback requires model re-deploy which takes ~5-10m for our pool.
Maya: I will trigger fallback for /v1/stream/generate and attach a filter for customers with high SLA. Command: `curl -X POST https://ops.internal/route/fallback -d '{"route":"/v1/stream/generate","fallback_model":"galaxy-fp16","scope":"streaming","reason":"precision-profile-tail-latency"}'`
DeployBot: deploy accepted, rollout id 7643, estimated propagation 18s.
Maya: started routing flip now. monitoring...
Ethan: quick check: p99 started to drop within 40s of the flip attempt (now 4.0s). p95 down to ~700ms. continuing.
Priya: investigating why scale coeffs would cause stalls: hypothesis — the int8 path includes an occasional slow path when a particular embedding block triggers an alignment fallback (vectorized vs scalar). For long contexts that block happens often.
Maya: confirm: stream stalls count decreasing but not gone. maybe some requests were pinned to nodes that still serve the int8 variant.
Ethan: running `inventory query --model galactica-13b --profile int8-lowscale` — found 6 nodes still at that profile (sync issue). kicking a hotpatch to force profile override.
Maya: hotpatch command sent: `redwood node override --nodes 12,23,47,91,105,118 --profile fp16-fallback`
DeployBot: override accepted, nodes restarting lightweight runtime; expect 45s until new profile binds.
Marco: notifying customers: "we've identified an internal precision rollout correlated with increased tail latency; routing to a stable variant; we expect normal latency within minutes. If you still see timeouts, escalate to support."
Maya: p99 now 2.9s, p95 480ms. That is back within SLO for most traffic. Collecting logs for postmortem.
Priya: saving a sample trace for further offline analysis: `s3://redwood-ops/trace-dumps/3693456789-sample-2.json` (contains token timing + dequant stack). Will analyze for exact code path where scalar fallback occurs.
Ethan: immediate mitigation summary: route-level fallback + node profile override. Root cause hypothesized: scale-table mismatch / slow scalar fallback in the new int8 kernel under long-context streaming.
Maya: opening incident in tracker: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-4821, tagging eng-runtime + eng-ml + customer-success.
Lena: oncall handoff plan: I'm staying for 30m to confirm stability, then handing to night oncall (Maya -> Lena_night). If anything reoccurs, PD escalation to SRE lead.
Marco: CS will follow up with impacted customers with an RCA note and temporary credits if needed.
Priya: action items: (1) reproduce slow path locally with long-context synthetic + int8-lowscale, (2) add defensive guard that disables int8 for streaming if any per-token dequantize loop > 20ms, (3) add telemetry for scalar fallback counts.
Ethan: I'll schedule a targeted Canary run with a tweaked scale-table and synthetic traffic 1h from now.
Maya: final note before handoff: incident marked mitigated, monitoring in watch mode for 60m. If p99 spikes above 3s again, @incident-bot should auto-page. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident status changed -> MITIGATED -> Monitoring. root_incident=INC-2026-4821
Lena: handing off to night oncall in 30m — please add any follow-ups to the incident ticket.
Maya: thanks team — will add collected logs and timeline to the ticket.
